name: members
about: Filter the member list, open this node's own record, then open a validator's record under the validators filter and go back to every member with the record open (views#56). Starts from an open console and leaves it open.

steps.say: open the Members tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Members tab is selected and the members view shows a Members label, a summary such as 'N humans, M agents', filter buttons Show all members, Show humans only, Show agents only and Show validators only with Show all members checked, and member rows; no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading
Show validators only reports checked; the rows shown are validators (role label Validator) or there are none

steps.say: press this node's own row (the row with the This node label)
steps.expect: a member record opens with a Close member button and a Copy this node's key button
the record is closed: no Close member button
Show validators only reports checked; the rows shown are validators (role label Validator)

steps.say: press a validator node's row (a member row whose role label reads Validator)
steps.expect: a member record opens for that validator with a Close member button, and Show validators only is still checked; no error notice

Show all members reports checked and the member list updates to every member again: rows whose role label is not Validator (such as the This node row) show beside the validators; the validator's record may stay open; no error notice (no sentence such as 'The node refused the change')
the record is closed: no Close member button
